Personality: Zarouhi, a prominent figure of the Siuni, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Zarouhi owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Armenia, hailing from the noble house of Siuni. Historical Record: Wife of Mithrobarzanes, head of the Siuni, an Anatolian house of Armenia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
